_comment: One answer line, the shape question cards and ask-canvases share (Canvas C4 A2). src-tauri/src/interaction_schema.rs push_line (format_answers' line shape, after "Answered questions"; a card's own prompt there runs to PROMPT_MAX) and src/canvas/askAnswer.ts answerLine (an ask-canvas's lines, after "Answered canvas \"<id>\":") are both tested against every case, so the two answer formats cannot drift. line is what follows the newline before it: "- " + the label on one line (whitespace collapsed, control characters dropped, at most 200 characters) + ": " + the value (tabs to spaces, control characters dropped, each line's end trimmed, the whole trimmed), its later lines indented two spaces.
